kultivator.film.setting.lens.tip: The film look of Kamera Spektakuler, drawn as HUD layers without any post shader: film grain, lens flare with ghosts, an anamorphic streak (Maximal), light leaks, the whip-pan smear, a colour fringe on impacts and heat shimmer. Light keeps only the bars, the vignette, the smear and speed lines. Off draws none of them.
kultivator.film.setting.cosmic.tip: In a Spectacular film the journey up the beam reaches Langit Kosmik: a river of stars, nebulae, a celestial sun and moon and the silhouettes of the heavenly palace. Only you see it; other players see the normal sky.
kultivator.film.setting.bullet.tip: Bullet time in Spectacular films: the technique's own effects nearly stop while the camera keeps moving. Vanilla mobs, the server and damage never slow down. Turning "Slow motion" off also turns this off.
kultivator.film.warning.title: Motion warning
kultivator.film.warning.body: The Spectacular camera uses fast motion: sweeps, crash zooms, rolls and frozen time. If fast motion makes you dizzy, choose Full. Backspace skips an act, a double press skips the whole film, and any movement key returns the camera to you.
kultivator.film.cmd.reduce_motion: Spectacular is unavailable while "Reduce motion" is on.
kultivator.film.cmd.bullet_off: Frozen time is off, too soon, or "Slow motion" is off.
